description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference (x-axis, ranging from 1 to 10) and the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) (y-axis, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5) for various retrieval methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and uses a linear scale with integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot includes seven distinct lines, each representing a different method: DPR w/o query (black, solid line), DPR w/ gold (yellow, dashed line), DPR w/ top-1 (green, dotted line), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple, dash-dotted line), DPR w/ random (blue, dashed line), and DPR w/ curriculum (red, dash-dotted line). The DPR w/ top-1 method shows a steep increase in MRR@10, starting at approximately 33.0 at S=1 and rising to 36.5 at S=10. The DPR w/ gold method follows a similar upward trend, starting at 33.0 and ending at 35.0. The DPR w/ curriculum method starts at approximately 35.1 and remains relatively stable, fluctuating slightly around 35.6. The DPR w/ random method begins at 34.8 and increases to 35.3. The DPR w/ bottom-1 method starts at 34.9 and remains relatively flat, ending at 34.8. The DPR w/o query method starts at 34.6 and remains flat across the entire range.
